QuestInfo.name: Lost Time
QuestInfo.0: You need to learn more about the darkness. Arwen the Fairy looks like a shady sort. Ask her!
QuestInfo.1: You need to learn more about the darkness. Arwen the Fairy looks like a shady sort. Ask her!
QuestInfo.2: No one seems to remember Aurora. Then who will know about the darkness?

0.0: Hello there, stranger. Can I help you?\r\n#L0##bTell me everything you know about the Black Mage. Quickly!#l\n#k
0.1: The Black Mage? Isn't he that old villain who was defeated by the 5 heroes centuries ago?\r\n#L0##bCenturies? It cannot be! But what of my hometown, Aurora?#l\n#k
0.2: Aurora? Never heard of it.\r\n#L0##bHm. There were only two people left there when I departed. I'm sure they're long gone.#l\n#k
0.3: What are you going on about? You're kind of weird, you know that?

yes.0: Get out of here. You're giving me the creeps.

no.0: Good riddance. You were giving me the creeps.
